Nice ambience but the most disappointing restaurant we ate at in all of Hoi An
Aug 2026 • Family
This was the first restaurant we ate at in Hoi An after arriving too tired to go into town. It was a big splurge, very expensive, but the ratings on Trip Advisor were so high we decided to go for it. It was INCREDIBLY disappointing. Nice ambience, friendly service, but the food was blah. One soup was very good but the other ten or so dishes we tried (we’re a family of four and shared, including appetizers and such) all tasted pretty much the same, with similar spices and similar ingredients, and not interesting. Like broccoli and cauliflower, something we could have ate anywhere in the world. 
Based on the nice ambience and good service, but incredibly disappointing flavor and high prices, I went back to the hotel and game the restaurant a 3. (They offered me a 10% refund if I would give a 5, since we complained in the satisfaction form they made us fill out after we ate, but I’d rather give an honest opinion to save other diners from the disappointment)
Then we spent 3 more days in Hoi An, and I decided to come back and give them a 2, grading on a curve for Hoi An. All restaurants in Hoi An have great service, but all the others we ate at also have fantastic food and better prices. Morning Glory for example is great - we ate at two of their locations. Even the street food we ate was better - at least it was interesting and at a good price. 
If you’re staying in the red bean’s hotel, the convenience is probably worthwhile. Or if you’re ok with bland food at high prices, it’s a good choice. Very nice ambience.

Delicious seafood pizza and wonderful service!
Oct 2026 • Family
Delicious seafood pizza and wonderful service! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had the seafood pizza at Red Bean Hoi An and it was excellent. The seafood was genuinely fresh, and because the pizza was baked directly in the wood-fired grill oven, it picked up a lovely smoky, grilled aroma that added real depth of flavor.
What made it even better was Thảo's warm and attentive service — friendly, proactive, and it made the whole meal more enjoyable. A special mention to Nguyễn and Hao, whose pizza cooking was impressive to watch.
Highly recommended if you're in Hoi An. Thank you for a great evening!
